title: miRBioGenAtlas: Sample-level multi-modal somatic alteration landscape of the miRNA biogenesis machinery across 32 TCGA cancer studies
description: Versioned, SHA-256-verified sample-level and aggregated genomic/transcriptomic resource covering 15 canonical microRNA biogenesis and regulatory genes across 32 TCGA PanCancer Atlas (2018) studies (33 cancer types; N = 10,195 tumours; 152,925 sample x gene records). Includes a frozen cBioPortal v7.2.3 (DB v3.1.0) input snapshot, sample-level discrete GISTIC2 (-2 to +2), continuous log2 copy-number ratios, matched chromosome-arm CNA status, 6,292 functionally annotated somatic variants (truncating LoF, curated catalytic/domain hotspots, in-frame indels, VUS missense), 72 structural variants, sample-level TMB/MSI/POLE hypermutator flags, matched mRNA expression (n = 9,620), synteny-aware patient-level burden across nested Core-10/Extended-12/Panel-14 gene-set tiers, aggregated frequency matrices, technical validation audit tables, and portable Python/R pipelines. Data CC BY 4.0; code MIT.
